about: Explicit context caching for the text agent (11-hardening:2, src/lib/agent/cache.ts). The static part of the prompt (rules, menu, tools; chatInstructions in src/lib/agent/instructions.ts) is stored once per backend, model, kiosk and locale with a 60 min TTL; each request names it with cachedContent and sends the order (status, dine option, cart) in a <current_order> block at the start of the latest user message. Cost: `npm run measure:cost` (MALO hero order, 4 user turns, 3 text runs each, en, on the Gemini API key: GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=api from the local .env, I-125). Pass rate and latency: `npm run eval:agent`. Counts, timings and verdicts only. Run on a laptop, 10-13; one set of 3 runs per variant, so durations are noisy.

variants.before: the code before this step (commit e2b6ad9): one system instruction per request with the current order before the menu, so its prefix changed with every cart change
variants.reorderOnly: this step's prompt split (static system, order in the user message) without the explicit cache (`npm run measure:cost -- --no-prompt-cache`); the implicit cache still applies
variants.explicitCache: this step as shipped: the static system and tools in an explicit cache

before.source: measure:cost run of 2026-10-13T04:52Z (copy of evidence/cost-per-order.json at that time)

reorderOnly.note: The implicit cache served only the first call of each order (7,639 tokens), even with the static part first.

explicitCache.source: measure:cost run of 2026-10-13T05:02Z, kept as evidence/cost-per-order.json
explicitCache.note: Every call named the cache (9,631 of about 9,700-10,300 prompt tokens). Run 2 (27.4 s) made three model calls on turn 1 instead of two. USD excludes cache storage (below).

textHeroOrder.usdPricesUsed: evidence/cost-per-order.json `prices` (gemini-3.8-flash input 0.75, cached input 0.075, output 3.75 USD per 1M tokens, read 10-13 from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing); scripts/cost.ts

cacheStorage.priceNote: Not on file and not read in this step (the step's shell had no web access): unverified. A person copies the context-caching storage price for gemini-3.8-flash from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing into evidence/cost-per-order.json `prices`.
cacheStorage.tokensPerCacheMeasuredFor: MALO BURGER, en (cachedContentTokenCount of every call)
cacheStorage.breakEven: One hero order saves 0.049984 USD of input, so one order per cache-hour covers a storage price up to 5.19 USD per 1M tokens per hour (0.049984 / 0.009631).
cacheStorage.mostCachesAtOnce: Per Cloud Run instance one cache per backend, kiosk and locale in use within the last 60 min: 3 kiosks x 2 locales = 6 on the API key (Vertex only during a fallback), x 3 instances (max-instances=3) = 18. A cache lives 60 min from creation and is not extended; the next request after that (or within its last 5 min) creates a new one, so an idle kiosk costs at most one cache-hour.

explicitCache.passed: 44/44 (14/14 on the API key + 30/30 on Vertex AI)

onApiKey.note: The first 14 cases passed; then the API key's prepaid credits ran out (HTTP 402 on every call, I-104) and the other 30 cases got no model answer (UPSTREAM), so they are not failures of the change.

onVertex.subset: the 30 cases without a model answer above, GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=vertex
onVertex.note: Vertex AI (location global) accepted the explicit cache for MALO and airport rail (no refusal logged); it refused one for the smaller Doughhouse prompt (HTTP 400, probably under its minimum size, unverified), and those two cases ran inline and passed.

latencySameCases.about: The 14 cases that passed on the API key in both runs (18 requests), before vs explicit cache; one run each.
latencySameCases.verdict: No latency gain measured: medians are within run-to-run noise or slower. The first request also waits for the cache to be created. The explicit cache is kept for cost only.

voice: Unchanged. Gemini Live cannot name a cache: in @google/genai 2.28 only GenerateContentConfig has `cachedContent`, LiveConnectConfig (and the ephemeral token's liveConnectConstraints) has none, so the Live instructions stay pinned in the token as before (buildInstructions output unchanged).
decision: Kept: the eval pass rate did not drop (44/44 before and after) and the text agent's input cost per hero order fell from 0.0588 to 0.0088 USD before storage (85% less), which covers storage at any price up to 5.19 USD per 1M tokens per hour with one order per cache-hour. Latency did not improve.
exposure: Cache names stay on the server: they are never in an API response, the session stream or a log line (logs carry the HTTP status only).
